card.line: Bozrah was a fortress city in Edom, home of an early Edomite king, and the prophets named it when they spoke of God's judgment on Edom.

moments.title: Jobab from Bozrah
moments.text: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place over Edom. Bozrah is named as the city he came from.

moments.title: A sacrifice in Bozrah
moments.text: Isaiah says the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, a great slaughter in the land of Edom. It is part of His day of vengeance, when He pays back wrong.

moments.title: One coming from Bozrah
moments.text: Isaiah asks who is coming from Edom, from Bozrah, in clothes stained crimson. The answer is, "It is I, proclaiming that right has won, mighty to save."

moments.title: Bozrah to be a ruin
moments.text: The LORD swears by Himself that Bozrah will become an empty waste, a disgrace, a ruin, and a curse. He says an eagle will spread its wings over Bozrah, and Edom's mighty men will be afraid.

moments.title: Fire on Bozrah's fortresses
moments.text: Because Edom pursued his brother with the sword, the LORD says He will send fire upon Teman to burn up the strong towers of Bozrah.
